attributes.name: Displacement
attributes.powers: When a monster deals damage to you, display this card. You may play this card even if you have played another spell on this check. While displayed, when you are dealt damage by a monster, roll 1d6; on a result other than 1, reduce the damage to 0.
attributes.recharge: At the start of your turn, if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish this card; otherwise, attempt an Arcane 14 check. If you succeed, recharge this card; if you fail, discard it.
